Name: NPC_AI_ACTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Virtual pad inputs for one AI action. The row ID is the action ID that AI Lua scripts use (the NPC_ATK enum); while the action runs, the character presses the keys below and holds the move direction.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Product
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Move Direction
Fields.Description: Stick direction input for the action. 0: no stick input.

Fields.Name: Key: 1
Fields.Description: First pad key input for the action. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Key: 2
Fields.Description: Second pad key input, pressed together with Key 1. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Key: 3
Fields.Description: Third pad key input, pressed together with Keys 1 and 2. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Hold Move Direction
Fields.Description: If ON, the move direction input is treated as held rather than tapped.

Fields.Name: Hold Key 1
Fields.Description: If ON, Key 1 is held down (long press) instead of tapped.

Fields.Name: Hold Key 2
Fields.Description: If ON, Key 2 is held down (long press) instead of tapped.

Fields.Name: Hold Key 3
Fields.Description: If ON, Key 3 is held down (long press) instead of tapped.

Fields.Name: Gesture ID
Fields.Description: Gesture to perform. Only used when one of the keys is set to Gesture.

Fields.Name: AI Goal Waits For Duration End
Fields.Description: If ON, the AI goal does not succeed until its lifetime runs out.
